title: galium cucullaris
intro: Galium cucullaris, commonly known as Chinese galium, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antipyretic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include modulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and relieving pain. The bioactive constituents of Galium cucullaris include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
